Class Scene

java.lang.Object
dev.marasmium.kit.applib.Scene
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputListener, NetListener
Direct Known Subclasses:
TitleScene
public abstract class Scene extends Object implements InputListener, NetListener
Abstract interface for a scene within the MarasmiumKit's application framework with callbacks for application processes. This class is intended to be managed (initialized and destroyed) by the framework's App class
